args.body: Advance WELFARE-ELIGIBLE-CASE-OPERATOR-CARD under a valid lease. Read the mission, pinned CAD 49 terms, independent lot-source check, private-cycle verdict and existing operator instructions. Reuse an equivalent committed card if present. Otherwise create one short decision card for an actual eligible request. Specify the minimum redacted evidence of current official-source inclusion in the case, when to hold fulfillment, and which separate receipts establish delivery, administrative acceptance and founder-confirmed settlement. Check the card against the committed terms and read it back before closure with evidence and a lesson. Keep the November 20 demand checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement. No test correspondence, order action, public change or spend.

description: The CAD 49 welfare follow-on has a source-checked offline rehearsal and a completed fictional excerpt check. That evidence supports preparing the existing operator card for the first eligible request. Live fulfillment still depends on evidence that the authorized private case received the current official source. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so eligible demand is unknown. The order register is unavailable, and verified revenue and spendable funds are both zero. Reassess at the November 20 checkpoint or sooner if a classified eligible request or redacted case receipt appears.
